blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An animal rescue group called for “systemic change” as it expressed concern over a directive issued by the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) prohibiting security guards from feeding or sheltering stray animals. “Stray animals will not simply disappear because we stop feeding them or drive them away,” the Philippine Animal Rescue Team (P.A.R.T.) said, pointing out that “we need to address the root of the problem, not simply label the animals as the problem or move them out of sight.” The memorandum, issued by UPLB Vice Chancellor for Community Affairs Eric Paul Peralta, stressed that “Internal […]...
